analogy.mechanism: neurogenesis of non-pluripotent C2C12 myoblast inducer
analogy.rationale: The class is defined by a phenotypic endpoint (myoblast neurogenesis) with no annotated targets, so its transcriptional signature is likely weak and nonspecific in these non-muscle cell lines; the closest reference classes are those that broadly perturb differentiation or chromatin state, but none should closely match.
